## Expected impact
```{=html}
<div class="impact-grid"><div class="impact-card"><h3>Better design data</h3><p>A more trustworthy non-linear pure-shear curve and shear strength improve analytical and finite-element predictions.</p></div><div class="impact-card"><h3>Standardization</h3><p>Experimental evidence supports the validation and evolution of UNE 0074:2023 and its broader adoption.</p></div><div class="impact-card"><h3>Accessible testing</h3><p>The uniaxial-machine fixture lowers an important equipment barrier to biaxial TC testing.</p></div><div class="impact-card"><h3>Regional capability</h3><p>New biaxial infrastructure at INAIA strengthens testing, training and collaboration capacity in Castilla-La Mancha.</p></div></div>
```

```{=html}
<div class="callout-impact"><h2>From testing to design</h2><p>The common thread is to reduce experimental uncertainty and turn it into more reliable properties for design, predictive simulation, standardization and transfer.</p></div>
```
